scripts.name: LOLBAS - T1040 - Nmcap.exe - Reconnaissance - Capture network traffic on windows to collect sensitive data. [60fbb08]
scripts.description: Command-line packet capture utility from Microsoft Network Monitor 3.x.. Start capture on all network adapters and save to specified .cap (circular) file. Optionally, one can add: - `/TerminateWhen /TimeAfter 30 seconds` to auto-terminate after a relative times (e.g. 30 seconds); - `/TerminateWhen /Time 04:52:00 AM 9/17/2025` to auto-terminate after a specific date/time; - `/TerminateWhen /KeyPress x` to terminate when a specific key is pressed. Use case: Capture network traffic on windows to collect sensitive data.. Privilege: Administrator.
